notes.title: Fixing a bug on the last girl.
notes.content: The indicator of the girl on the exercise bike did not rise, the bug has been fixed, I'm sorry who faced such a problem. The bug has already been fixed, and the new build has been uploaded. Don't forget to update the game. Thank you.

notes.title: Added achievements
notes.content:
Thanks for being so active and leaving such kind feedback—your support means a lot to me!
In this update, I've added achievements, fixed some annoying bugs, and boosted performance.
To mark the occasion, enjoy a sweet 25% off!
Thanks again, and enjoy the game! 🎮✨

notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
Thanks for all your activity and kind words — I really appreciate your support.
[h1]In this update:[/h1]
- Removed the traffic light mechanic (got a lot of negative feedback).
- Also polished the girls' eye movements — now they blink naturally and show more emotion.
Thanks again, and enjoy the game! 🚀
